148: // Wraps the function and measures its (async) execution time
149: const collectDurationPromise = (name: string, func: (...args: any) => Promise<any>) => {
150:   return async (...args: any) => {
151:     const end = startupGauge.startTimer({ task: name })
152:     try {
153:       const res = await func(...args)
154:       end()
155:       return res
156:     } catch (err) {
157:       console.error('Error in timed startup function: ' + name, err)
158:       throw err
159:     }
160:   }
161: }
